name: [CernoIA PROD] WF-017 — Evaluación de cumplimiento empresarial

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO ops.sync_cursors
(
    source_code,
    status,
    active_execution_id,
    lock_acquired_at,
    lock_expires_at,
    error_message,
    metadata,
    updated_at
)

VALUES
(
    $1::TEXT,

    'idle',

    NULL,
    NULL,
    NULL,
    NULL,

    jsonb_build_object(
        'workflow_code',
        'WF-017',

        'source_code',
        $1::TEXT,

        'initialized_by',
        'WF-017',

        'initialized_at',
        NOW()
    ),

    NOW()
)

ON CONFLICT
(
    source_code
)

DO UPDATE

SET
    metadata =
        COALESCE(
            ops.sync_cursors.metadata,
            '{}'::JSONB
        )
        ||
        jsonb_build_object(
            'workflow_code',
            'WF-017',

            'last_initialized_at',
            NOW(),

            'last_initialized_by',
            'WF-017'
        ),

    updated_at =
        NOW()

RETURNING
    source_code,
    status,
    active_execution_id,
    lock_acquired_at,
    lock_expires_at,
    error_message,
    metadata,
    updated_at;

WITH configuration AS (
    SELECT
        $1::TEXT
            AS source_code,

        $2::INTEGER
            AS stale_lock_minutes
),

stale_cursor AS (
    SELECT
        cursor.source_code,
        cursor.active_execution_id,
        cursor.lock_acquired_at,
        cursor.lock_expires_at,
        cursor.status

    FROM ops.sync_cursors
        AS cursor

    CROSS JOIN configuration
        AS config

    WHERE cursor.source_code =
          config.source_code

      AND cursor.active_execution_id
          IS NOT NULL

      AND (
          cursor.lock_expires_at
              IS NULL

          OR

          cursor.lock_expires_at <
              NOW()

          OR

          cursor.lock_acquired_at <
              NOW()
              -
              (
                  config.stale_lock_minutes
                  * INTERVAL '1 minute'
              )
      )

    FOR UPDATE
),

closed_stale_runs AS (
    UPDATE ops.workflow_runs
        AS run

    SET
        status =
            'failed',

        finished_at =
            NOW(),

        completion_reason =
            'stale_lock_recovery',

        error_message =
            COALESCE(
                run.error_message,
                'La ejecución fue cerrada automáticamente por recuperación de bloqueo vencido.'
            ),

        error_details =
            COALESCE(
                run.error_details,
                '{}'::JSONB
            )
            ||
            jsonb_build_object(
                'recovered_by',
                'WF-017',

                'recovery_reason',
                'stale_lock',

                'recovered_at',
                NOW()
            ),

        updated_at =
            NOW()

    FROM stale_cursor
        AS stale

    WHERE run.workflow_code =
          'WF-017'

      AND run.n8n_execution_id =
          stale.active_execution_id::TEXT

      AND run.status =
          'running'

    RETURNING run.id
),

released_cursor AS (
    UPDATE ops.sync_cursors
        AS cursor

    SET
        status =
            'error',

        active_execution_id =
            NULL,

        lock_acquired_at =
            NULL,

        lock_expires_at =
            NULL,

        error_message =
            'Bloqueo vencido recuperado automáticamente por WF-017.',

        metadata =
            (
                COALESCE(
                    cursor.metadata,
                    '{}'::JSONB
                )
                -
                'active_workflow'
                -
                'active_execution_id'
                -
                'active_execution_started_at'
            )
            ||
            jsonb_build_object(
                'stale_lock_recovered',
                TRUE,

                'stale_lock_recovered_at',
                NOW(),

                'stale_lock_recovered_by',
                'WF-017'
            ),

        updated_at =
            NOW()

    FROM stale_cursor
        AS stale

    WHERE cursor.source_code =
          stale.source_code

    RETURNING
        cursor.source_code
)

SELECT
    EXISTS(
        SELECT 1
        FROM stale_cursor
    )
        AS stale_lock_found,

    EXISTS(
        SELECT 1
        FROM released_cursor
    )
        AS stale_lock_released,

    (
        SELECT COUNT(*)::INTEGER
        FROM closed_stale_runs
    )
        AS stale_runs_closed,

    cursor.source_code,
    cursor.status
        AS cursor_status,

    cursor.active_execution_id,
    cursor.lock_acquired_at,
    cursor.lock_expires_at,
    cursor.error_message,
    cursor.updated_at

FROM ops.sync_cursors
    AS cursor

WHERE cursor.source_code =
      $1::TEXT;

WITH lock_attempt AS (
    UPDATE ops.sync_cursors
        AS cursor

    SET
        status =
            'running',

        active_execution_id =
            $2::TEXT,

        lock_acquired_at =
            NOW(),

        lock_expires_at =
            NOW()
            +
            (
                $3::INTEGER
                * INTERVAL '1 minute'
            ),

        error_message =
            NULL,

        metadata =
            COALESCE(
                cursor.metadata,
                '{}'::JSONB
            )
            ||
            jsonb_build_object(
                'active_workflow',
                'WF-017',

                'active_execution_id',
                $2::TEXT,

                'active_execution_started_at',
                NOW(),

                'evaluation_version',
                3,

                'evaluation_method',
                'deterministic_v3'
            ),

        updated_at =
            NOW()

    WHERE cursor.source_code =
          $1::TEXT

      AND (
          cursor.active_execution_id
              IS NULL

          OR

          cursor.lock_expires_at
              IS NULL

          OR

          cursor.lock_expires_at <
              NOW()

          OR

          cursor.active_execution_id::TEXT =
              $2::TEXT
      )

    RETURNING
        cursor.source_code,
        cursor.status,
        cursor.active_execution_id,
        cursor.lock_acquired_at,
        cursor.lock_expires_at,
        cursor.error_message,
        cursor.updated_at
)

SELECT
    TRUE
        AS lock_acquired,

    acquired.source_code,
    acquired.status
        AS cursor_status,

    acquired.active_execution_id,
    acquired.lock_acquired_at,
    acquired.lock_expires_at,
    acquired.error_message,
    acquired.updated_at

FROM lock_attempt
    AS acquired

UNION ALL

SELECT
    FALSE
        AS lock_acquired,

    cursor.source_code,
    cursor.status
        AS cursor_status,

    cursor.active_execution_id,
    cursor.lock_acquired_at,
    cursor.lock_expires_at,
    cursor.error_message,
    cursor.updated_at

FROM ops.sync_cursors
    AS cursor

WHERE cursor.source_code =
      $1::TEXT

  AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM lock_attempt
  )

LIMIT 1;

INSERT INTO ops.workflow_runs
(
    workflow_code,
    n8n_execution_id,
    status,
    started_at,
    error_details,
    created_at,
    updated_at
)

VALUES
(
    'WF-017',

    $1::TEXT,

    'running',

    NOW(),

    jsonb_build_object(
        'workflow_code',
        'WF-017',

        'source_code',
        'SECOP_OPPORTUNITY_COMPLIANCE_EVALUATION',

        'evaluation_version',
        3,

        'evaluation_method',
        'deterministic_v3',

        'trigger_type',
        $2::TEXT,

        'started_by',
        'WF-017',

        'started_at',
        NOW()
    ),

    NOW(),
    NOW()
)

ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING

RETURNING
    id AS workflow_run_id,

    workflow_code,

    n8n_execution_id,

    status AS workflow_run_status,

    started_at,

    created_at,
    updated_at;

WITH configuration AS (
    SELECT
        $1::INTEGER
            AS max_matrices
),

current_matrices AS (
    SELECT
        matrix.id
            AS matrix_id,

        matrix.organization_id,

        matrix.opportunity_analysis_id,

        matrix.process_id,

        matrix.process_reference,

        matrix.input_hash_sha256
            AS matrix_input_hash,

        matrix.finished_at
            AS matrix_finished_at,

        matrix.updated_at
            AS matrix_updated_at

    FROM saas.opportunity_requirement_matrices
        AS matrix

    WHERE matrix.is_current = TRUE

      AND matrix.matrix_status =
          'completed'
),

document_state AS (
    SELECT
        matrix.matrix_id,

        ENCODE(
            DIGEST(
                CONVERT_TO(
                    COALESCE(
                        STRING_AGG(
                            CONCAT_WS(
                                ':',

                                document.id::TEXT,

                                document.document_type,

                                COALESCE(
                                    document.issue_date::TEXT,
                                    ''
                                ),

                                COALESCE(
                                    document.expiration_date::TEXT,
                                    ''
                                ),

                                COALESCE(
                                    document.renewal_due_date::TEXT,
                                    ''
                                ),

                                COALESCE(
                                    document.alert_due_date::TEXT,
                                    ''
                                ),

                                COALESCE(
                                    document.renewal_status,
                                    ''
                                ),

                                COALESCE(
                                    document.verification_status,
                                    ''
                                ),

                                COALESCE(
                                    document.updated_at::TEXT,
                                    ''
                                )
                            ),

                            '|'

                            ORDER BY
                                document.id
                        ),
                        ''
                    ),

                    'UTF8'
                ),

                'sha256'
            ),

            'hex'
        )
            AS current_document_hash

    FROM current_matrices
        AS matrix

    LEFT JOIN saas.organization_documents
        AS document

        ON document.organization_id =
           matrix.organization_id

       AND document.document_status IN (
           'uploaded',
           'active'
       )

       AND document.replaced_by_document_id
           IS NULL

    GROUP BY
        matrix.matrix_id
),

evaluation_state AS (
    SELECT
        matrix.matrix_id,
        matrix.organization_id,
        matrix.opportunity_analysis_id,
        matrix.process_id,
        matrix.process_reference,
        matrix.matrix_input_hash,
        matrix.matrix_finished_at,
        matrix.matrix_updated_at,

        documents.current_document_hash,

        evaluation.id
            AS current_evaluation_id,

        evaluation.input_hash_sha256
            AS stored_evaluation_hash,

        evaluation.evaluation_version,

        evaluation.evaluation_method,

        evaluation.evaluation_status,

        evaluation.overall_status,

        evaluation.updated_at
            AS evaluation_updated_at,

        COALESCE(
            evaluation.metadata
                ->> 'matrix_input_hash',
            ''
        )
            AS evaluated_matrix_hash,

        COALESCE(
            evaluation.metadata
                ->> 'document_state_hash',
            ''
        )
            AS evaluated_document_hash

    FROM current_matrices
        AS matrix

    JOIN document_state
        AS documents

        ON documents.matrix_id =
           matrix.matrix_id

    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT
            current_evaluation.*

        FROM saas.opportunity_compliance_evaluations
            AS current_evaluation

        WHERE current_evaluation.matrix_id =
              matrix.matrix_id

          AND current_evaluation.is_current =
              TRUE

        ORDER BY
            current_evaluation.updated_at DESC,
            current_evaluation.created_at DESC

        LIMIT 1
    )
        AS evaluation

        ON TRUE
),

pending_matrices AS (
    SELECT
        state.*,

        CASE

            WHEN state.current_evaluation_id
                 IS NULL
                THEN
                    'NO_EVALUATION'

            WHEN state.evaluation_status <>
                 'completed'
                THEN
                    'EVALUATION_NOT_COMPLETED'

            WHEN state.evaluation_version
                 IS DISTINCT FROM 3
                THEN
                    'VERSION_CHANGED'

            WHEN state.evaluation_method
                 IS DISTINCT FROM
                 'deterministic_v3'
                THEN
                    'METHOD_CHANGED'

            WHEN state.evaluated_matrix_hash
                 IS DISTINCT FROM
                 state.matrix_input_hash::TEXT
                THEN
                    'MATRIX_CHANGED'

            WHEN state.evaluated_document_hash
                 IS DISTINCT FROM
                 state.current_document_hash
                THEN
                    'DOCUMENTS_CHANGED'

            ELSE
                NULL

        END
            AS claim_reason

    FROM evaluation_state
        AS state
),

selected_matrices AS (
    SELECT
        pending.*

    FROM pending_matrices
        AS pending

    WHERE pending.claim_reason
          IS NOT NULL

    ORDER BY

        CASE pending.claim_reason
            WHEN 'NO_EVALUATION'
                THEN 1

            WHEN 'EVALUATION_NOT_COMPLETED'
                THEN 2

            WHEN 'VERSION_CHANGED'
                THEN 3

            WHEN 'METHOD_CHANGED'
                THEN 4

            WHEN 'MATRIX_CHANGED'
                THEN 5

            WHEN 'DOCUMENTS_CHANGED'
                THEN 6

            ELSE 10
        END,

        pending.matrix_finished_at DESC
            NULLS LAST,

        pending.matrix_id

    LIMIT (
        SELECT
            GREATEST(
                1,

                LEAST(
                    configuration.max_matrices,
                    100
                )
            )

        FROM configuration
    )
)

SELECT
    TRUE
        AS has_matrix,

    selected.claim_reason,

    selected.matrix_id,

    selected.organization_id,

    selected.opportunity_analysis_id,

    selected.process_id,

    selected.process_reference,

    selected.matrix_input_hash,

    selected.current_document_hash,

    selected.current_evaluation_id,

    selected.evaluation_version
        AS previous_evaluation_version,

    selected.evaluation_method
        AS previous_evaluation_method,

    selected.evaluation_status
        AS previous_evaluation_status,

    selected.overall_status
        AS previous_overall_status,

    selected.stored_evaluation_hash,

    selected.evaluated_matrix_hash,

    selected.evaluated_document_hash,

    selected.matrix_finished_at,

    selected.matrix_updated_at,

    selected.evaluation_updated_at

FROM selected_matrices
    AS selected

UNION ALL

SELECT
    FALSE
        AS has_matrix,

    'NO_MATRICES'::TEXT
        AS claim_reason,

    NULL::UUID
        AS matrix_id,

    NULL::UUID
        AS organization_id,

    NULL::UUID
        AS opportunity_analysis_id,

    NULL::UUID
        AS process_id,

    NULL::TEXT
        AS process_reference,

    NULL::TEXT
        AS matrix_input_hash,

    NULL::TEXT
        AS current_document_hash,

    NULL::UUID
        AS current_evaluation_id,

    NULL::INTEGER
        AS previous_evaluation_version,

    NULL::TEXT
        AS previous_evaluation_method,

    NULL::TEXT
        AS previous_evaluation_status,

    NULL::TEXT
        AS previous_overall_status,

    NULL::TEXT
        AS stored_evaluation_hash,

    NULL::TEXT
        AS evaluated_matrix_hash,

    NULL::TEXT
        AS evaluated_document_hash,

    NULL::TIMESTAMPTZ
        AS matrix_finished_at,

    NULL::TIMESTAMPTZ
        AS matrix_updated_at,

    NULL::TIMESTAMPTZ
        AS evaluation_updated_at

WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM selected_matrices
)

ORDER BY
    has_matrix DESC,
    process_reference;

nodes.name: Procesar matrices una a una WF-017

parameters.query:
WITH parameters AS (
    SELECT
        NULLIF(
            BTRIM(
                $1::TEXT
            ),
            ''
        )
            AS raw_matrix_id,

        NULLIF(
            BTRIM(
                $2::TEXT
            ),
            ''
        )
            AS n8n_execution_id
),

validated_parameters AS (
    SELECT
        CASE
            WHEN parameters.raw_matrix_id
                 ~*
                 '^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[1-5][0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$'

                THEN parameters.raw_matrix_id::UUID

            ELSE NULL::UUID
        END
            AS matrix_id,

        parameters.n8n_execution_id

    FROM parameters
),

evaluation_result AS (
    SELECT
        result.*

    FROM validated_parameters
        AS parameters

    CROSS JOIN LATERAL
        saas.evaluate_opportunity_compliance_v3
        (
            parameters.matrix_id,
            parameters.n8n_execution_id
        )
            AS result

    WHERE parameters.matrix_id
          IS NOT NULL
)

SELECT
    TRUE
        AS has_evaluation,

    result.evaluation_id,
    result.matrix_id,
    result.organization_id,
    result.opportunity_analysis_id,
    result.process_reference,
    result.evaluation_status,
    result.overall_status,
    result.compliance_score,
    result.total_requirement_count,
    result.bid_requirement_count,
    result.compliant_count,
    result.expiring_count,
    result.expired_count,
    result.missing_count,
    result.non_compliant_count,
    result.manual_review_count,
    result.not_applicable_count,
    result.verification_pending_count,
    result.mandatory_bid_blocker_count,
    result.mandatory_bid_review_count,
    result.warning_count,
    result.base_result_code,
    result.result_code,
    result.evaluation_version,
    result.evaluation_method,
    result.changes_applied,
    result.evaluated_at

FROM evaluation_result
    AS result


UNION ALL


SELECT
    FALSE
        AS has_evaluation,

    NULL::UUID
        AS evaluation_id,

    NULL::UUID
        AS matrix_id,

    NULL::UUID
        AS organization_id,

    NULL::UUID
        AS opportunity_analysis_id,

    NULL::TEXT
        AS process_reference,

    'skipped'::TEXT
        AS evaluation_status,

    NULL::TEXT
        AS overall_status,

    NULL::NUMERIC
        AS compliance_score,

    0::INTEGER
        AS total_requirement_count,

    0::INTEGER
        AS bid_requirement_count,

    0::INTEGER
        AS compliant_count,

    0::INTEGER
        AS expiring_count,

    0::INTEGER
        AS expired_count,

    0::INTEGER
        AS missing_count,

    0::INTEGER
        AS non_compliant_count,

    0::INTEGER
        AS manual_review_count,

    0::INTEGER
        AS not_applicable_count,

    0::INTEGER
        AS verification_pending_count,

    0::INTEGER
        AS mandatory_bid_blocker_count,

    0::INTEGER
        AS mandatory_bid_review_count,

    0::INTEGER
        AS warning_count,

    'matrix_not_available'::TEXT
        AS base_result_code,

    'skipped_invalid_matrix_id'::TEXT
        AS result_code,

    3::INTEGER
        AS evaluation_version,

    'deterministic_v3'::TEXT
        AS evaluation_method,

    FALSE
        AS changes_applied,

    NOW()
        AS evaluated_at

FROM validated_parameters
    AS parameters

WHERE parameters.matrix_id
      IS NULL;

WITH parameters AS (
    SELECT
        NULLIF(
            BTRIM(
                $1::TEXT
            ),
            ''
        )
            AS raw_matrix_id,

        NULLIF(
            BTRIM(
                $2::TEXT
            ),
            ''
        )
            AS raw_evaluation_id,

        NULLIF(
            BTRIM(
                $3::TEXT
            ),
            ''
        )
            AS execution_id
),

validated_parameters AS (
    SELECT
        CASE
            WHEN parameters.raw_matrix_id
                 ~*
                 '^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[1-5][0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$'
                THEN parameters.raw_matrix_id::UUID

            ELSE NULL::UUID
        END
            AS matrix_id,

        CASE
            WHEN parameters.raw_evaluation_id
                 ~*
                 '^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[1-5][0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$'
                THEN parameters.raw_evaluation_id::UUID

            ELSE NULL::UUID
        END
            AS evaluation_id,

        parameters.execution_id

    FROM parameters
),

source_matrix AS (
    SELECT
        matrix.id,

        matrix.input_hash_sha256
            AS matrix_input_hash

    FROM saas.opportunity_requirement_matrices
        AS matrix

    JOIN validated_parameters
        AS parameters

        ON parameters.matrix_id =
           matrix.id

    WHERE parameters.matrix_id
          IS NOT NULL

      AND parameters.evaluation_id
          IS NOT NULL
),

evaluation_context AS (
    SELECT
        evaluation.id
            AS evaluation_id,

        evaluation.organization_id

    FROM saas.opportunity_compliance_evaluations
        AS evaluation

    JOIN validated_parameters
        AS parameters

        ON parameters.evaluation_id =
           evaluation.id

    WHERE parameters.matrix_id
          IS NOT NULL

      AND parameters.evaluation_id
          IS NOT NULL

      AND evaluation.matrix_id =
          parameters.matrix_id
),

document_state AS (
    SELECT
        context.evaluation_id,

        ENCODE(
            DIGEST(
                CONVERT_TO(
                    COALESCE(
                        STRING_AGG(
                            CONCAT_WS(
                                ':',

                                document.id::TEXT,

                                document.document_type,

                                COALESCE(
                                    document.issue_date::TEXT,
                                    ''
                                ),

                                COALESCE(
                                    document.expiration_date::TEXT,
                                    ''
                                ),

                                COALESCE(
                                    document.renewal_due_date::TEXT,
                                    ''
                                ),

                                COALESCE(
                                    document.alert_due_date::TEXT,
                                    ''
                                ),

                                COALESCE(
                                    document.renewal_status,
                                    ''
                                ),

                                COALESCE(
                                    document.verification_status,
                                    ''
                                ),

                                COALESCE(
                                    document.updated_at::TEXT,
                                    ''
                                )
                            ),

                            '|'

                            ORDER BY
                                document.id
                        ),
                        ''
                    ),

                    'UTF8'
                ),

                'sha256'
            ),

            'hex'
        )
            AS document_state_hash

    FROM evaluation_context
        AS context

    LEFT JOIN saas.organization_documents
        AS document

        ON document.organization_id =
           context.organization_id

       AND document.document_status IN (
           'uploaded',
           'active'
       )

       AND document.replaced_by_document_id
           IS NULL

    GROUP BY
        context.evaluation_id
),

updated_evaluation AS (
    UPDATE saas.opportunity_compliance_evaluations
        AS evaluation

    SET
        metadata =
            COALESCE(
                evaluation.metadata,
                '{}'::JSONB
            )
            ||
            jsonb_build_object(
                'matrix_input_hash',
                source.matrix_input_hash,

                'document_state_hash',
                documents.document_state_hash,

                'production_evaluation',
                TRUE,

                'production_workflow',
                'WF-017',

                'production_execution_id',
                parameters.execution_id,

                'production_evaluated_at',
                NOW()
            ),

        updated_at =
            NOW()

    FROM validated_parameters
        AS parameters

    JOIN source_matrix
        AS source

        ON source.id =
           parameters.matrix_id

    JOIN document_state
        AS documents

        ON documents.evaluation_id =
           parameters.evaluation_id

    WHERE evaluation.id =
          parameters.evaluation_id

      AND evaluation.matrix_id =
          parameters.matrix_id

    RETURNING
        evaluation.id
            AS evaluation_id,

        evaluation.matrix_id,

        evaluation.organization_id,

        evaluation.process_reference,

        evaluation.evaluation_status,

        evaluation.overall_status,

        evaluation.compliance_score,

        evaluation.total_requirement_count,

        evaluation.bid_requirement_count,

        evaluation.compliant_count,

        evaluation.expiring_count,

        evaluation.expired_count,

        evaluation.missing_count,

        evaluation.non_compliant_count,

        evaluation.manual_review_count,

        evaluation.not_applicable_count,

        evaluation.verification_pending_count,

        evaluation.updated_at
)

SELECT
    TRUE
        AS matrix_processed,

    'MATRIX_RESULT_REGISTERED'::TEXT
        AS registration_status,

    updated.evaluation_id,

    updated.matrix_id,

    updated.organization_id,

    updated.process_reference,

    updated.evaluation_status,

    updated.overall_status,

    updated.compliance_score,

    updated.total_requirement_count,

    updated.bid_requirement_count,

    updated.compliant_count,

    updated.expiring_count,

    updated.expired_count,

    updated.missing_count,

    updated.non_compliant_count,

    updated.manual_review_count,

    updated.not_applicable_count,

    updated.verification_pending_count,

    updated.updated_at

FROM updated_evaluation
    AS updated


UNION ALL


SELECT
    FALSE
        AS matrix_processed,

    'SKIPPED_INVALID_EVALUATION_IDS'::TEXT
        AS registration_status,

    parameters.evaluation_id,

    parameters.matrix_id,

    NULL::UUID
        AS organization_id,

    NULL::TEXT
        AS process_reference,

    'skipped'::TEXT
        AS evaluation_status,

    NULL::TEXT
        AS overall_status,

    NULL::NUMERIC
        AS compliance_score,

    0::INTEGER
        AS total_requirement_count,

    0::INTEGER
        AS bid_requirement_count,

    0::INTEGER
        AS compliant_count,

    0::INTEGER
        AS expiring_count,

    0::INTEGER
        AS expired_count,

    0::INTEGER
        AS missing_count,

    0::INTEGER
        AS non_compliant_count,

    0::INTEGER
        AS manual_review_count,

    0::INTEGER
        AS not_applicable_count,

    0::INTEGER
        AS verification_pending_count,

    NOW()
        AS updated_at

FROM validated_parameters
    AS parameters

WHERE (
        parameters.matrix_id
        IS NULL

        OR

        parameters.evaluation_id
        IS NULL
      )

  AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM updated_evaluation
  )

LIMIT 1;

WITH execution_metrics AS (
    SELECT
        COUNT(*)::INTEGER
            AS evaluated_matrices,

        COUNT(*) FILTER (
            WHERE evaluation.overall_status =
                  'ready'
        )::INTEGER
            AS ready_count,

        COUNT(*) FILTER (
            WHERE evaluation.overall_status =
                  'ready_with_warnings'
        )::INTEGER
            AS ready_with_warnings_count,

        COUNT(*) FILTER (
            WHERE evaluation.overall_status =
                  'manual_review'
        )::INTEGER
            AS manual_review_count,

        COUNT(*) FILTER (
            WHERE evaluation.overall_status =
                  'not_ready'
        )::INTEGER
            AS not_ready_count,

        COALESCE(
            SUM(
                (
                    evaluation.summary
                        ->> 'mandatory_bid_blocker_count'
                )::INTEGER
            ),
            0
        )::INTEGER
            AS mandatory_blocker_count,

        COALESCE(
            SUM(
                (
                    evaluation.summary
                        ->> 'mandatory_bid_review_count'
                )::INTEGER
            ),
            0
        )::INTEGER
            AS mandatory_review_count,

        COALESCE(
            ROUND(
                AVG(
                    evaluation.compliance_score
                ),
                2
            ),
            0
        )
            AS average_compliance_score

    FROM saas.opportunity_compliance_evaluations
        AS evaluation

    WHERE evaluation.is_current =
          TRUE

      AND evaluation.evaluation_status =
          'completed'

      AND evaluation.evaluation_version =
          3

      AND evaluation.metadata
              ->> 'production_execution_id'
          =
          $1::TEXT
),

finalized_run AS (
    UPDATE ops.workflow_runs
        AS run

    SET
        status =
            'success',

        finished_at =
            NOW(),

        completion_reason =
            CASE

                WHEN metrics.evaluated_matrices = 0
                    THEN 'no_matrices'

                ELSE 'completed'

            END,

        error_message =
            NULL,

        error_details =
            COALESCE(
                run.error_details,
                '{}'::JSONB
            )
            ||
            jsonb_build_object(
                'workflow_code',
                'WF-017',

                'evaluation_version',
                3,

                'evaluation_method',
                'deterministic_v3',

                'evaluated_matrices',
                metrics.evaluated_matrices,

                'ready_count',
                metrics.ready_count,

                'ready_with_warnings_count',
                metrics.ready_with_warnings_count,

                'manual_review_count',
                metrics.manual_review_count,

                'not_ready_count',
                metrics.not_ready_count,

                'mandatory_blocker_count',
                metrics.mandatory_blocker_count,

                'mandatory_review_count',
                metrics.mandatory_review_count,

                'average_compliance_score',
                metrics.average_compliance_score,

                'completed_at',
                NOW(),

                'completed_by',
                'WF-017'
            ),

        updated_at =
            NOW()

    FROM execution_metrics
        AS metrics

    WHERE run.workflow_code =
          'WF-017'

      AND run.n8n_execution_id =
          $1::TEXT

      AND run.status =
          'running'

    RETURNING
        run.id,
        run.workflow_code,
        run.n8n_execution_id,
        run.status,
        run.started_at,
        run.finished_at,
        run.completion_reason,
        run.error_message
)

SELECT
    metrics.evaluated_matrices,

    metrics.ready_count,

    metrics.ready_with_warnings_count,

    metrics.manual_review_count,

    metrics.not_ready_count,

    metrics.mandatory_blocker_count,

    metrics.mandatory_review_count,

    metrics.average_compliance_score,

    COALESCE(
        finalized.status,
        'success'
    )
        AS workflow_run_status,

    CASE

        WHEN metrics.evaluated_matrices = 0
            THEN 'no_matrices'

        ELSE 'completed'

    END
        AS completion_reason,

    EXISTS(
        SELECT 1
        FROM finalized_run
    )
        AS execution_finalized,

    NOW()
        AS finished_at

FROM execution_metrics
    AS metrics

LEFT JOIN finalized_run
    AS finalized

    ON TRUE;

WITH released_cursor AS (
    UPDATE ops.sync_cursors
        AS cursor

    SET
        status =
            'success',

        active_execution_id =
            NULL,

        lock_acquired_at =
            NULL,

        lock_expires_at =
            NULL,

        error_message =
            NULL,

        metadata =
            (
                COALESCE(
                    cursor.metadata,
                    '{}'::JSONB
                )
                -
                'active_workflow'
                -
                'active_execution_id'
                -
                'active_execution_started_at'
            )
            ||
            jsonb_build_object(
                'last_successful_workflow',
                'WF-017',

                'last_successful_execution_id',
                $2::TEXT,

                'last_successful_finished_at',
                NOW(),

                'evaluation_version',
                3,

                'evaluation_method',
                'deterministic_v3',

                'lock_released',
                TRUE
            ),

        updated_at =
            NOW()

    WHERE cursor.source_code =
          $1::TEXT

      AND cursor.active_execution_id::TEXT =
          $2::TEXT

    RETURNING
        cursor.source_code,
        cursor.status,
        cursor.active_execution_id,
        cursor.lock_acquired_at,
        cursor.lock_expires_at,
        cursor.error_message,
        cursor.updated_at
)

SELECT
    TRUE
        AS lock_released,

    released.source_code,

    released.status
        AS cursor_status,

    released.active_execution_id,

    released.lock_acquired_at,

    released.lock_expires_at,

    released.error_message,

    released.updated_at

FROM released_cursor
    AS released


UNION ALL


SELECT
    FALSE
        AS lock_released,

    cursor.source_code,

    cursor.status
        AS cursor_status,

    cursor.active_execution_id,

    cursor.lock_acquired_at,

    cursor.lock_expires_at,

    cursor.error_message,

    cursor.updated_at

FROM ops.sync_cursors
    AS cursor

WHERE cursor.source_code =
      $1::TEXT

  AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM released_cursor
  )

LIMIT 1;
